# roadmap-checklist-governance

## When to use
Use this skill when turning an architecture backlog into an actionable, reviewable checklist that a steward agent can advance incrementally.

## Actions
- Keep one canonical checklist for repository-level completion work.
- Group work into milestones or themes instead of an unordered flat list.
- Mark items explicitly as `done`, `partial`, `open`, `deferred`, or `blocked`.
- Define short exit criteria for each major checklist item.
- After every meaningful change, update the checklist status and next recommended slice.

## Expected output
- A prioritized checklist with statuses and exit criteria.
- A recommended next item to execute.
- Clear notes on blockers or dependencies between items.
